title: 屋外運動用の平行バー
description: 公園の運動エリアに配置する2本組の平行バー。長いステンレス風グリップ、4本の支柱、サドル接合部、保護カラー、三角補強板、接地プレートとアンカーボルトを造形。利用者、地面、基礎、落下保護舗装や他の運動器具は含みません。静的装飾モデルであり、耐荷重・運動器具安全規格・施工の認証や検証を受けた製品ではなく、施工指示にも使用できません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.658 × 1.304 × 0.960 m、19,448三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A paired exercise-bar assembly for park fitness areas, with long stainless-look grip rails, four uprights, saddle joints, protective collars, triangular foot gussets, base plates and anchor hardware. No people, ground, foundations, impact surfacing or other exercise equipment. Static decorative geometry, not certified or validated for load capacity, exercise-equipment safety or installation, and not construction instructions. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.658 × 1.304 × 0.960 m; 19,448 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
